summary: Werewolf Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated August 21, 2026, under which its wholly owned subsidiary Wave Atlantis Merger Sub will merge into Ambros Therapeutics, with Ambros surviving as a Werewolf subsidiary in a reverse-triangular stock-for-stock deal intended as a tax-free reorganization. Ambros preferred converts to common, then each Ambros share converts into Werewolf common at an unspecified exchange ratio, with pre-funded warrants available above a beneficial ownership cap; Ambros options are assumed and adjusted. No price, premium, advisor, or close date given. Watch the exchange ratio, PIPE terms, and ownership split.
